root_cause.text: The ALSA `ctxfi` driver's `ct_vm_map()` function hardcodes the use of the first page table page (`vm->ptp[0].area`) for mapping PTEs, leading to an out-of-bounds memory access when aggregate memory allocations exceed the capacity of a single page table page after `CT_PTP_NUM` was increased to 4.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff reverts `CT_PTP_NUM` from 4 to 1 in `sound/pci/ctxfi/ctvmem.h`, and the commit description states that "ct_vm_map() always uses PTEs in vm->ptp[0].area regardless of CT_PTP_NUM" and "When aggregate memory allocations exceed this limit, ct_vm_map() tries to access beyond the allocated space and causes a page fault".
